verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS with a Customer Portal, so in-product AI insights are a fair question to ask. The evidence covers verification sessions, liveness checks, webhooks, manual review in the portal and PDF export, but nothing describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the customer's data. The automated verification decisions themselves are a different capability and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
